transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I've been feeling severely depressed and down for about 11 months now, and it just doesn't seem to lift. It got to the point where I knew I couldn't handle it on my own anymore, which is why I decided to come in and seek some help today.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful life event, like a breakup, job loss, or move? Or did they come on without any clear trigger?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. There wasn't a specific event or trigger that I can point to. These feelings just seemed to develop and get worse gradually over the last 11 months.
Before these last 11 months, had you been feeling down or depressed on and off for at least 2 years, or is this the first time it has lasted this long?
I don't really recall having these feelings on and off before this. As far as I can remember, this is the first time I've felt like this, and it has just been constant for the past 11 months.
Along with feeling depressed, have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yes, absolutely. I’ve completely lost interest in the hobbies and activities I used to love, and nothing seems to bring me any joy or pleasure anymore. It just feels like I can't experience happiness from anything right now.
Have you also had changes in your sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, or feelings of worthlessness during this time?

Yes, I've been struggling a lot with feeling completely worthless and useless, like I have no value at all. As for my sleep, appetite, energy, and concentration, I haven't really noticed any significant changes in those areas.
During these 11 months, have there been any periods of at least 2 months when you felt mostly back to normal, or has the depression been present nearly every day the whole time?
No, there haven't been any periods where I felt back to normal at all. The depression has been present nearly every single day for the entire 11 months.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to die, hurt yourself, or that life isn’t worth living?

Yes, I have those thoughts quite often. I frequently find myself wishing I just wouldn't wake up in the morning, and it feels like my life isn't worth living anymore. I've also had recurring thoughts about wanting to end my life.
Have you thought about how you might end your life, or made any plans to do so?

Yes, I have. I’ve gone as far as planning out exactly how and when to do it, and I even started gathering things to make it happen. It’s gotten to a point where I feel very close to actually going through with it.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days when you felt unusually energized or euphoric, needed much less sleep, or were more impulsive than usual?
No, I have never experienced periods of high energy, euphoria, or needing less sleep. My mood has just been consistently low and empty this whole time. I've never had those kinds of ups.
When you’re feeling this depressed, have you had any experiences like hearing voices, seeing things others don’t, or strongly believing things that others say aren’t true?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't hear voices, see things that aren't there, or hold beliefs that others tell me aren't true.
